name: Inky tools
description: Admin utilities for the inky13 panel: add gallery images by URL or clipboard paste, and publish the one-shot MQTT command that opens the ArduinoOTA window.

settings.name: device_id
settings.label: Device id
settings.help: Tesserae device id / MQTT topic prefix for the OTA command.

settings.name: default_folder
settings.label: Default gallery folder
settings.help: Folder id pre-selected on the import tab. Blank auto-selects the first gallery folder.

settings.name: max_size_mb
settings.label: Max image size (MB)
settings.help: Cap on bytes fetched from a URL or received from the clipboard.

settings.name: allowed_hosts
settings.label: Allowed URL hosts (optional)
settings.help: Comma-separated hostnames allowed for URL imports. Blank allows any host except local/special addresses.

settings.name: token
settings.label: OTA command token
settings.help: Must match TESS_OTA_CMD_TOKEN in the firmware's src/secrets.h.
